subject: Post-demo: Data handling carve-out and retention follow-up
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@bluebridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Data handling carve-out and retention follow-up

Thanks again for the demo time today — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned on the retention/data-handling items you flagged: 

Summary of what BlueBridge needs: 
- Zero-retention for direct PII fields ingested into requests (names, SSNs, precise contact details) for model training/retention.
- Shortened system/log retention (7-30 days) for non-PII telemetry.
- Redacted audit logs that still provide actionability for compliance but remove PII tokens.
- Ability to restrict data residency to us-east for both storage and audit log access.

What Redwood can offer (initial): 
- For Private deployments: configuration to keep PII in memory only (no disk persistence) + KMS integration and automated zero-ttl deletion policies.
- For Hosted: we can support a shortened-logs profile with explicit redaction rules; true zero-retention for PII on Hosted is a special-case carve-out (requires signed contractual language and an agreed security review).
- Embedding and KV caching: we can expire embeddings on a custom schedule per-account (we'll need to agree on sync windows).

Next steps / asks from BlueBridge: 
1) Please send the data map you mentioned (field-level classification + volumes).
2) Confirm which models/endpoints you plan to use for the PoC (generation vs. embeddings).
3) Share the names/emails for your procurement and contracts folks (we'll loop in legal for retention carve-out language).

I'll attach a starter retention carve-out clause and an internal summary for our security team to review. If you prefer, we can do a 30-min follow-up with our security engineer to walk through technical controls.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: BlueBridge-DataMap.xlsx (requested), redwood_proposed_msa_retention_clause.txt (draft)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@bluebridge.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@bluebridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Data handling carve-out and retention follow-up

Camila — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We've attached the field-level classification (see BlueBridge-DataClassification.pdf). Rough counts: ~12M requests/month for the PoC; ~5% contain direct PII.
- Zero-retention for PII is critical for our customers in the clinical pilot. By zero-retention we mean: no written logs or persistent storage of raw PII fields; ability to audit that data was purged. Are your retention controls auditable?
- For the PoC we'll use Redwood hosted endpoints for speed, but we may move to a Private deployment for production if the carve-out requires it.

Procurement: contracts@bluebridge.ai will own the purchase order. Priya (cc'd) is our head of product security and will review the proposed clause.

Can you also confirm what kind of evidence you can provide to satisfy our auditors (e.g., deletion event logs, KMS rotation records)?

- Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Security, BlueBridge Analytics
jordan.blake@bluebridge.ai

Attachment: BlueBridge-DataClassification.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@bluebridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Data handling carve-out and retention follow-up

Jordan — appreciate the details and the classification doc. Short answers up front: 

- Auditable deletion evidence: yes. For Private deployments we can emit signed deletion events (timestamp + key id) which you can surface to auditors. For Hosted we can provide deletion event logs and KMS rotation proof, subject to contract language about log access.
- Redaction: we support configurable token-level redaction in logs. That will remove PII while preserving the shape of audit events.
- Embeddings retention: we can parameterize TTL per-account. Default hosted TTL is 30 days, but we can shorten to 7 days or implement manual purge triggers during PoC.

A few things we need from you to finalize the technical plan: 
1) Confirm target endpoints (generation vs embeddings) and expected token sizes so we can size caching/eviction.
2) Do you need realtime deletion APIs (we offer a programmatic purge endpoint) or are scheduled purges OK?

I've forwarded your classification doc to our security engineering team and attached a draft MSA clause that would formalize a zero-retention carve-out for PII on Hosted under agreed conditions. If you're open, Marissa can propose a 6-week PoC commercial structure that ties contract milestones to delivery of the deletion evidence.

Quote of your message for clarity: 
> Zero-retention for PII is critical for our customers in the clinical pilot. By zero-retention we mean: no written logs or persistent storage of raw PII fields; ability to audit that data was purged. Are your retention controls auditable?

Let me know and we'll align legal and security.

—
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@bluebridge.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, contracts@bluebridge.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Data handling carve-out and retention follow-up

Jordan / team — looping in a quick commercial proposal to help move this forward. Suggested PoC/commercial outline: 

- 6-week paid PoC tied to delivery of: (a) retention configuration deployed to your tenant, (b) deletion evidence for a 48-hour synthetic exercise, (c) a remediation plan for audit findings.
- PoC fee: $12,500 (covers dedicated onboarding & security runbook).
- If you convert to a 12-month commitment within 30 days post-PoC, we'll credit the PoC fee and include the retention carve-out language in the MSA.

I've attached a suggested MSA clause for the carve-out (redwood_proposed_msa_retention_clause.txt). Legal can edit — but this should speed procurement. 

Camila: please confirm whether the deletion evidence will be the signed deletion events (for Private) and KMS/deletion logs for Hosted.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_proposed_msa_retention_clause.txt

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@bluebridge.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Data handling carve-out and retention follow-up

Camila / Marissa — this all looks reasonable. A couple of final items before we kick off the PoC: 

1) Can you confirm the exact retention window you can guarantee for embeddings during the Hosted PoC (we'd prefer 7 days)?
2) We need redacted audit logs that still have a deterministic record id for tracing (so we can show chain-of-custody without exposing PII). Can Redwood support redaction that keeps stable event IDs?
3) Contracts: contracts@bluebridge.ai will send a PO once legal tweaks are minor. Please cc me on any contract threads.

Assuming answers to (1) and (2) look good, we'll purchase the PoC and schedule the kickoff. Also please include the security engineer in the kickoff — Priya will coordinate availability.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Security, BlueBridge Analytics
